provenance.canonical-source: apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/progress.tsx — 31 lines, the SOLE source for every style cell. It is two elements and two class strings: Root `relative h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-primary/20`, Indicator `h-full w-full flex-1 bg-primary transition-all` plus an inline transform. There is no cva, no variants object, no size axis and no props of its own beyond what it forwards. Token values from apps/v4/app/globals.css. Examples read for composition: registry/new-york-v4/examples/progress-demo.tsx, apps/v4/examples/radix/{progress-demo,progress-label,progress-rtl,progress-controlled}.tsx. Read ONLY to fix the boundary (no style value taken from them): registry/bases/{radix,base,aria}/ui/progress.tsx and apps/v4/content/docs/components/radix/progress.mdx.
provenance.behaviour-source: primitives/packages/react/progress/src/progress.tsx (the Radix clone) — BEHAVIOUR AND ARIA ONLY, per the brief. It supplies role="progressbar", aria-valuemax={max}, aria-valuemin={0} (HARDCODED — there is no min prop), aria-valuenow={isNumber(value) ? value : undefined}, aria-valuetext={valueLabel} from a getValueLabel prop defaulting to `${Math.round((value / max) * 100)}%`, and data-state / data-value / data-max on BOTH the Root and the Indicator. DEFAULT_MAX = 100; an invalid max or value is console.error'd and coerced.
provenance.indicator-bg: class `bg-primary` -> globals.css:107 --primary: oklch(0% 0 0) (light) / :150 oklch(0.922 0 0) (dark). Near-black in light and near-white in dark — a shadcn progress INVERTS, where Salt's accent holds still.
provenance.groove-bg: class `bg-primary/20` on the ROOT. Tailwind v4 compiles the /20 modifier to color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 20%, transparent) — the same derivation input.shadcn.json, select.shadcn.json and badge.shadcn.json used for their /30, /50, /60 and /90 modifiers, written out per mode rather than as an expression over another slot so no custom property has to resolve across a mode boundary (lesson 2). THE ONLY TRACK OF THE THREE DERIVED FROM THE INDICATOR'S OWN COLOUR.
provenance.track-radius: class `rounded-full`. [R] concrete 9999px — a bare Tailwind utility with no shadcn token behind it, per docs/foundations/shape.md line 10, the same [S/R] treatment badge.shadcn.json's shape row recorded.
provenance.track-height: class `h-2` = 8px, density-invariant (shadcn has no density capability at all — docs/foundations/density.md).
provenance.transition: class `transition-all` on the Indicator — property list [S]; duration 150ms and cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) are [R] because Tailwind is not vendored in this clone, the same caveat input/select/dialog/tabs/badge.shadcn.json all carry. Unlike Salt's, this transition DOES cover the property the component animates.
provenance.indeterminate: SOURCED ABSENCE WITH A VISIBLE CONSEQUENCE. Radix fully supports indeterminate (value null -> data-state="indeterminate", aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext both omitted), but progress.tsx's style line is `transform: translateX(-${100 - (value || 0)}%)`, so null coerces to 0 and an indeterminate shadcn progress renders as a MOTIONLESS EMPTY BAR. Its indeterminate support is ARIA-only. Confirmed by grep: no keyframe, no `animate-` utility and no `data-[state=indeterminate]:` rule anywhere in the file.
provenance.rtl: apps/v4/examples/radix/progress-rtl.tsx adds `className="rtl:rotate-180"` to the whole bar — the consumer flipping a physical-axis transform by hand, because translateX is not direction-aware. Recorded as evidence for structure.fill-mechanism; not modelled.

structure.shape.source: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — progress.tsx is a horizontal bar and there is no circular progress file anywhere in the clone. shadcn's circular loading affordance is the separate Spinner component (lucide Loader2Icon), already matrixed.

structure.fill-mechanism.source: progress.tsx: style={{ transform: `translateX(-${100 - (value || 0)}%)` }} inline on a full-width indicator inside an overflow-hidden track

structure.buffer.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — neither progress.tsx nor the Radix primitive has a second value of any kind

structure.stop-indicator.note: no end marker; and see state.complete, which is the same idea expressed as a data attribute nothing styles

structure.label.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE in the component. Its own examples supply one by COMPOSITION — progress-label.tsx wraps the bar in Field + FieldLabel and hand-writes 66%, i.e. consumer-owned text the component neither formats nor keeps in sync.

structure.indeterminate-band.note: See provenance.indeterminate — the mode exists in ARIA and renders as an empty bar. A sourced absence, not an omission.

structure.indeterminate-circular.note: no circular form at all; the indeterminate circular case is shadcn's Spinner, owned by docs/SPINNER-MATRIX.md

behavior.value-range.source: Radix takes `max` (DEFAULT_MAX = 100) and hardcodes aria-valuemin={0}; there is NO min prop, so a non-zero floor is unreachable

behavior.determinacy-detection.source: getProgressState(value, max) returns 'indeterminate' | 'loading' | 'complete', published as data-state on BOTH the Root and the Indicator

behavior.value-now.source: aria-valuenow={isNumber(value) ? value : undefined} — NOT rounded, unlike Salt

behavior.value-text.source: aria-valuetext={valueLabel}, from getValueLabel defaulting to `${Math.round((value / max) * 100)}%` — announced but never drawn, the exact inverse of Salt

behavior.label-formatting.note: no visible label to format; the percentage exists only in aria-valuetext

prop.determinacy.note: CAPABILITY LIST. Both values are real at the ARIA level (Radix distinguishes them) and only one is real visually (structure.indeterminate-band is off), which is precisely the divergence worth carrying.

prop.max.source: Radix DEFAULT_MAX = 100, applied through isValidMaxNumber with a console.error on an invalid value

prop.min.note: A CEILING, NOT AN OMISSION — Radix has no min prop and hardcodes aria-valuemin={0}.

slot.label.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION to `field` / `label`, both unbuilt — progress-label.tsx and progress-rtl.tsx both build the visible percentage out of Field + FieldLabel.

slot.composes.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION: `field`/`label` (its own labelled examples) and `card` (registry/bases/*/blocks/preview-02/cards/savings-progress.tsx puts a progress inside a card). Neutral placeholders in the harness.

state.rest.value: bg-primary over bg-primary/20 — the track is the fill at 20%

state.indeterminate.value: ARIA-only: data-state=indeterminate, no valuenow, no valuetext, EMPTY BAR

state.complete.source: getProgressState returns 'complete' when value === max, written as data-state on both elements — and NOTHING in progress.tsx selects on it, so a finished bar looks like a 99% one

state.interaction-states.source: grepped: progress.tsx carries none of the focus-visible:/aria-invalid: groups its sibling components paste in, and has no disabled handling

style.root.min-width.note: `w-full` only — a shadcn progress takes whatever width its parent gives it, where a Salt one demands 400px

style.groove.height.note: in source the groove IS the track element (bg-primary/20 sits on the Root); the chassis paints it on a full-bleed child, which is byte-equivalent here — declared approximation

style.groove.shape.note: the radius lives on the track element (style.track.shape), which in source is the same element

style.indicator.shape.note: the indicator is clipped by the track's own rounded-full + overflow-hidden rather than carrying a radius

style.indicator.transition.note: class `transition-all` — property list [S], duration/easing [R] (Tailwind not vendored). Unlike Salt's, it covers the property that actually moves.
